## Getting started

Install `sqlpipe` with the installation command:

```sh
curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh
```

Create a file named `sqlpipe.yaml` in your project directory.

Add the source and destination details that `sqlpipe` requires.

Save the file after you add the configuration.

If you store the file in another directory, use its path in the command.

Run the first data transfer:

```sh
sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml
```

The `--config` option tells `sqlpipe` to read the configuration from `sqlpipe.yaml`.

If the command reports an error, read the error message.

Make sure that the source and destination details match your environment.

Make sure that the database credentials allow the required connections.

Keep `sqlpipe.yaml` out of public repositories when it contains credentials.

Add the file to `.gitignore` if it contains passwords or access tokens.

Run the command again after you correct the configuration.

Use the same configuration file for later runs when the source and destination do not change.
